_comment: Copy this file to contacts.json and edit it. contacts.json is gitignored.

_policies.auto: bot writes AND sends the reply on its own
_policies.draft: bot writes the reply and shows it in the terminal, sends nothing
_policies.never: bot stays silent, but still learns from replies you type yourself

_persona_help: Who the bot writes as. Used in the prompt so the model knows whose voice it is copying. Keep 'about' short.
_me_help: Your display name EXACTLY as it appears in a chat export. Open any _chat.txt from a WhatsApp export and look at the name on your own messages. It is often a nickname or symbol, not your real name.
_aliases_help: How people tag you in groups. Include your phone number without the + sign -- WhatsApp stores mentions as @<number> internally, which is the most reliable match.
_default_help: Policy for anyone not listed below. Start with 'draft'.
_contacts_help: Chat names EXACTLY as they appear in WhatsApp, including emoji. Groups go here too.
